business_process: Emergency alarm call-out and spill and H2S response
description: SCADA alarm call-out of H2S, tank high-level, SWD high-pressure, and well shutdown events to the on-call phone; spill and release reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hardwired shutdowns and local beacons still work without SCADA, but nobody is told remotely after hours; an oil discharge that reaches water must be reported to the National Response Center immediately (40 CFR 110.6); H2S exposure risk to staff and neighbors
manual_workaround: On-call Lease Operator drives the tank battery, SWD facility, and the 6 sour wells nearest homes every 2 hours; spill reports by phone from the emergency response plan binder
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-06 (field office); SYS-08; SYS-05 (smartphones)
dependent_third_parties: SCADA vendor (cloud alarm service); cellular carrier; electric utility
dependent_people_or_facilities: Field Superintendent; Lease Operators; field office

description: SWD facility injects about 1,400 barrels of produced water per day into 2 SWD wells; SCADA monitors injection pressure, rate, and tank levels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Water tanks at the battery fill in about 12 hours at full rate; after that the producing wells must be shut in; injection pressure limits are a permit condition
manual_workaround: Run the SWD pumps from the local PLC panel with a Lease Operator on site; shut in the highest water-cut wells first to buy time

description: Monitoring of 16 producing wells and the tank battery from the SCADA host and phones; remote start and stop; pump-off controller settings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pump-off controllers run their own logic, and Lease Operators already visit every well daily, so the field keeps producing; past 3 days the 2 Lease Operators and the Field Superintendent cannot keep up twice-daily checks and failed pumps go unnoticed; about $3,000 a day of revenue if all wells stop
manual_workaround: Manual operations: twice-daily routes, hand gauging, local start and stop at each controller; Field Superintendent sets the shut-in order if staff cannot cover the field
dependent_third_parties: SCADA integrator; cellular carrier; radio tower lease
dependent_people_or_facilities: Lease Operators; Field Technician; Field Superintendent

description: Tank gauging, paper run tickets signed by the Lease Operator and the truck driver, and loading of the purchaser's trucks at the tank battery
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tank storage holds about 3 weeks of production, but the purchaser's trucks load about every 5 days and a missed load delays sales; run tickets are the basis for sales and royalties
manual_workaround: Paper run tickets are the record; photos are texted to the Production Accountant; manual tank strapping tables in the tank battery binder
dependent_third_parties: Crude purchaser and its trucking carrier

business_process: Production accounting, state reports, and royalty distribution
description: Monthly volume allocation, state production and injection reports, royalty payments to about 140 owners, and joint interest billing to 2 partners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Royalties go out monthly and owners notice late payments; state reports have fixed due dates; volumes can be rebuilt from run tickets and SCADA tank data
manual_workaround: Rebuild volumes from paper run tickets; delay the royalty run and send owners a short notice; file state reports from paper records

business_process: Payables, banking, and crude sales settlement
description: Vendor payments, purchaser sales statements, bank reconciliation, ACH approvals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Purchasers pay monthly; vendors tolerate a short delay; cash reserve covers about 60 days
manual_workaround: Paper checks for urgent payables; bank branch for urgent transfers

description: Biweekly payroll for 7 employees through an outside payroll service; onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; a missed payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Ask the payroll service to repeat the prior payroll

description: Scheduling the contract pulling unit and parts for failed pumps; predictive maintenance alerts (pilot)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: One failed stripper well loses about 3.4 barrels a day; the pulling unit contractor books jobs by phone
manual_workaround: Phone the pulling unit contractor; whiteboard job list at the field office
dependent_third_parties: Pulling unit contractor; parts supplier; SCADA vendor

description: Licensed 3D seismic interpretation, reservoir maps, and drilling plans shared with the 2 partners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No daily operation depends on it; the main risk is confidentiality (license terms and trade secret), not downtime
manual_workaround: Defer analysis; work from the Owner's encrypted laptop
dependent_third_parties: Seismic data licensor; productivity suite vendor
